bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New features and fixes enhance user experience for Insiders in the Canary Channel.
2025 Gaming Innovations - Windows 11 enhances gaming with handheld devices and DirectX advancements for immersive experiences.
AI-Driven JavaScript Modernization - New tool simplifies upgrading JavaScript/TypeScript projects in Visual Studio Code.
Faster Web Apps Proposal - Microsoft introduces Delayed Message Timing API to enhance web app performance.
Shai-Hulud 2.0 Attack Guidance - Microsoft outlines defense strategies against significant supply chain attacks.
Cyber Defense Evolution - Microsoft emphasizes the importance of graph-based thinking in cybersecurity strategies.
Node.js on Azure Functions - Simplified hosting for Node.js MCP servers now available on Azure Functions.
Beazley Collaboration for Cyber Resilience - New partnership enhances incident response capabilities for Microsoft customers.
AI Dev Days Event - Join Microsoft for a two-day virtual event focused on AI innovations and development.
Microsoft's Email Security Leadership - Recognized as a leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Email Security.
